remarks: SUMMER 2026! Thinking of next summer already? This beauty is available on a monthly basis starting June 15th through August 15th. Escape to the heart of Rowayton this summer at 9 Barclay Court-a charming, in-town getaway just steps from the beach, Village shops, restaurants, Pinkney Park, and all the best of this coastal community. This beautifully maintained home offers bright, comfortable living spaces, a well-appointed kitchen, and inviting indoor/outdoor flow perfect for warm-weather entertaining. Enjoy quiet mornings on the patio, bike to Bayley Beach in minutes, and spend your evenings strolling to town for ice cream or live music. A rare chance to experience Rowayton's summer lifestyle from an ideal, walk-to-everything location.
